labelPolicy: Supported means supported by the explicitly supplied record, not independently proven in the world. Unsupported means not warranted by this record, not necessarily false. Uncertain means conflicting or insufficiently qualified source status or precision policy prevents a definitive decision. Aggregate mixed claims by unsupported > uncertain > supported.
